scope: Potential free lagged Serie A statistics source for the unchanged original frozen V2 only. This is a public-rights and provenance audit, not permission to ingest or infer.

dataset.stated_source: Official Lega Serie A Match Report PDFs
dataset.stated_coverage: 2026/27 season; README says the dataset is updated weekly
dataset.report_metadata: README says reports.csv records competition, publication date and last-update date
dataset.correction_behavior: README says reports can be corrected 0–12 days after a match

rights.repository_license_scope: The LICENSE text grants rights to the Software and associated documentation; it is not a separate upstream data license and cannot establish Lega Serie A database/content rights.

reasons: Official Lega Serie A terms restrict extraction or use of platform content, including data mining and robots, without express written consent.
The third-party repository's MIT license is a software license and does not establish rights to upstream Lega Serie A match-report data.
The repository's automated weekly PDF extraction pipeline is not evidence that this project is authorized to repeat that extraction.
Publication and last-update dates are described at date granularity; exact per-stat first-observed timestamps are not documented in the inspected README.
Reports may be corrected 0–12 days after a match, so a later CSV snapshot can revise historical statistics.
Exact parity with the original frozen 19-feature order and the source-before-quote chronology has not been verified.
The original frozen V2 source contract does not authorize adding this provider.
